notes: AdapLDP-FL is the existing compatible adapter; noise=0 matches archived runs, no formal LDP claim.
HEFedAvg retains the inherited fixed-mask proxy, not a full encryption implementation.
Shakespeare partitions are newly generated IID/label Dirichlet with the official train/test split preserved.
20 additional Adap-CTA jobs cover the five original paper dataset/backbone pairs over four distributions.
Inherited VGG11 class is retained verbatim (its actual architecture has 13 convolution layers).
CIFAR-10 d0.5 inherited shards mix runs (92637 examples), so d0.5/d0.8 are newly generated with the existing pooled 75/25 utility.
CIFAR-100 original raw files are damaged; fresh official data and fresh partitions are required, with no claim of matching historical partitions.
User revision 2026-10-21: all training uses lr=0.01; delete lr=0.001 artifacts and retrain from initialization. Old controls, weights, RNG, and curves are not resumed.

72 fresh lr=0.01 jobs, including 12 FedCEO-compatible adapter runs: CIFAR10/ResNet 8 configurations and Shakespeare/Transformer 4 distributions. FedCEO remains an update-space adapter, not per-example DP-SGD.
2026-10-21: 21 not-yet-started jobs reassigned to server17-server26; running jobs and training protocol retained. Actual GPUs: server17-21 ~32GB, server22-26 ~16GB.
2026-10-21: nine pending jobs promoted to parallel queues after measured GPU/CPU/memory checks; six owner changes; active training processes retained.
2026-10-21: 8 pending jobs promoted during all_pending after measured GPU/CPU/memory checks; active training processes retained.

2026-10-22: migrated three pending LDP-FL jobs to verified idle servers 10/15; secondary queues detached safely after active child verification.
2026-10-22: moved pending Cifar100/VGG11/d0.5 LDP-FL to idle server25; stage and validate the existing partition archive before training.
2026-10-22: moved the two remaining queued main-table LDP-FL jobs to idle, resource-checked servers14/22; partitions staged and verified before launch.

2026-10-22: finalized spare-GPU placements after verifying the d0.8 LDP job had already started on server2; Cifar100/VGG IID LDP goes to server22, Cifar10/VGG d0.2 FedPVR goes to server14, active server18 LSTM is preserved.
2026-10-23: resumed Shakespeare/LSTM DPFedAvg from the matching 720-round checkpoint and H5 on server1; preserve prior partial logs and curves.

2026-11-01: Adap-CTA/Shakespeare/LSTM repaired run only; decision_l=6, balanced control, 100-round warmup, 800 rounds, seed=0, lr=0.01; remote goal retrain_AdapCTA_lstm_warmup100_balanced_s1; partial artifacts sync to results/training/main_table/Shakespeare/lstm/d=0.2/Adap-CTA.

2026-11-01: repaired HEFedAvg CIFAR-10/100 ResNet/VGG11 matrix completed on server2/3 (16/16, 800 rounds each); old low curves backed up under final_logs/*/HEFedAvg/curves.old_bad_20261101.h5, formal curves and accuracy figures refreshed.
Public release: machine-specific archived path labels are omitted; corresponding *_path_sha256 fields retain their digests. Use results/training/summary.csv for the published artifact paths.
